faqs.question: How many pounds is 1 kilogram?
faqs.answer: 1 kilogram equals 2.20462 pounds. Conversely, 1 pound equals 0.453592 kilograms.

faqs.question: How to quickly estimate kg to lbs?
faqs.answer: Multiply by 2.2 for a quick mental estimate. E.g. 50 kg ≈ 110 lbs. The true value is 110.23 lbs, so the error is under 0.1%.
